shared_schema.input: Synthetic documents with explicitly annotated topic/value/quote claims and optional start offsets; research_questions; request query/topics/team_online; action catalog and completed_actions; extraction_schema.
shared_schema.output: One status-bearing JSON object containing versioned deep, journey, support, extract stage envelopes.
shared_schema.validation: One validate function verifies input types, unique identifiers, evidence spans and acyclic action prerequisites. Every stage output is validated against its deterministic contract before the next stage consumes it.
shared_schema.offsets: Zero-based, end-exclusive Python Unicode character offsets, not UTF-8 byte offsets.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated agreed/disputed findings, documentary evidence and unresolved questions; only agreed topics satisfy action requirements.
Validated two-step plan or blocked outcome plus full research evidence; plan topics augment requested support topics.
Validated support answer and grounded fact spans; extracted values cannot bypass the support stage.

behavior.research: Aggregates all supplied documents, exact-string agreement, retained conflicting alternatives, deduplicated evidence and unresolved questions. One-document agreement is not independent corroboration; document_count exposes this.
behavior.journey: Request-topic overlap then action-id ranking; searches for a feasible ordered pair, verifies completion prerequisites and evidence availability. A blocked result is returned rather than inventing a second step.
behavior.support: General topic-based grounded informational response, source citations, unresolved-topic disclosure, recommended but never executed actions, honest online/offline escalation language.
behavior.extraction: Schema-driven string/integer/boolean extraction with optional typed enum constraints, support-answer spans, original document citations, required/optional missing-field reporting.
behavior.errors: CLI validation and file errors produce one JSON error object and exit 2; successful processing exits 0 even when a journey is blocked or required extraction fields are missing.
behavior.determinism: No clocks, randomness, network requests, provider calls or optional LLM hooks.

included: Shared validation and integrated data lineage
excluded: Live customer actions or ticket creation
limitations: Input requires explicit topic labels and evidence annotations.
Agreement uses exact strings and does not establish real-world truth.
Requested free-text query is preserved; explicit request topics drive routing.
Recomputed validation prioritizes clarity over large-corpus performance.

cli_example.stdout: One JSON object with status ok

coverage: Extraction types, enum, missing fields and Unicode spans
CLI success, invalid schema, invalid JSON, missing file and usage errors
